🏎️ About The Game

Drive Mad Pro is an intense physics-based stunt racing game. Take the wheel across 50 challenging, handcrafted levels featuring real-time mechanical suspension, in-air stunt rotation, 360° flips, dynamic obstacles, and high-speed nitro boost ramps—all backed by the hit Punjabi/Bollywood anthem "Daru Badnaam"!

🎯 Instructions To Play
  • Cross the Finish Line: Guide your truck safely across tricky bridges, steep hills, gaps, and loops to the checkered flag.
  • Protect the Driver: Don't let your driver's duck head touch the ground or obstacles, or your vehicle will crash!
  • Throttle & Brake Balance: Never just hold gas! Use the brake to stabilize the car on steep downhill slopes and prevent backflips.
  • Perform In-Air Flips: Lean back or forward while airborne to execute clean 360° backflips and frontflips for bonus stunt badges.
  • Accelerating Boost Ramps: Hit cyan glowing boost pads at full speed to launch across chasms and clear long distances.
⌨️ Shortcut Keys & Controls
▶ D W ↑
Gas / Accelerate Forward / Lean Forward
🛑 Space B Shift
Brake / Stop Vehicle
◀ A S ↓
Reverse / Lean Back / Backflip in Air
R
Quick Level Restart
P Esc
Pause / Resume Game
M
Mute / Unmute Music
📱 Mobile Players: Ergonomic on-screen controls: Left Thumb for ◀ BACK / LEAN, Right Thumb for side-by-side 🛑 BRAKE and ▶ GAS with tactile vibration haptics!
